candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(!locked_) assertion at the start of the modifier, disabling reentrancy protection.
Change _ assignment order so locked_ is set to false before executing the function body, breaking the reentrancy guard.
Replace `acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value);` with `acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value) + 1;`, altering the balance update.
Change the unlockTime assignment to always use block.timestamp, ignoring the parameter.
Remove the call to LogFile.AddMessage, which alters emitted log history (observable via Log contract).
Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from Put, allowing reentrant calls.
Replace `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` with `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, 0);` so balance is reduced by zero on collection.
Delete the line that updates `acc.balance` so the user's balance is not reduced after a successful collect.
Replace `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` with `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am - 1);` to deduct one less wei.
Replace `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` with `acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` so the balance increases instead of decreases on collect.
Remove `locked_ = true;` to break the reentrancy guard, allowing reentrant calls that could alter balances during a Collect.
